result.title: ReliaGuard: Reconstruction-Aware Watermarking for Source Attribution and Blind Edit Localization
result.summary: Generative image editing facilitates content creation but complicates source attribution and edit verification. Existing watermarking methods combine copyright protection with tamper localization, yet background reconstruction can weaken spatial evidence even when source identifiers remain recoverable. We propose ReliaGuard, a reconstruction-aware watermarking framework for source attribution and blind edit localization. The writer optimizes keyed feature responses in both the protected image and its variational autoencoder reconstruction under image-distortion and source-preservation constraints. Using only the received image and a secret key, the reader combines watermark responses with local image context through residual evidence refinement and predicts an edit mask through native-resolution-guided multiscale reading. It is trained on complete editing outputs, locally spliced counterparts, and processed versions of both. On an independent test set of 300 source images and 900 editing cases from three image domains, our method achieves edit-region intersection-over-union scores of 85.61% for complete outputs and 94.90% for locally spliced outputs at a threshold calibrated to a nominal 1% background false-positive rate on complete outputs. The complete-output result exceeds the strongest baseline by 45.02 percentage points, while decoded identifier-bit accuracy reaches 100% in both conditions. Across seven families of image processing, the corresponding localization scores are 81.01% and 86.49%, with identifier-bit accuracies of 92.76% and 92.79%, respectively. These results support source recovery and blind edit localization under background reconstruction and subsequent image processing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ReliaGuard：一种重建感知的水印框架，在受保护图像及其 VAE 重建上优化密钥特征响应，读者端仅用收到的图像与密钥，通过残差证据细化与原生分辨率引导的多尺度读取预测编辑掩码，以实现来源归因与盲编辑定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「基于水印响应做残差证据细化并输出空间证据掩码」的做法，以及用掩码 IoU 加背景假阳性率校准来评价证据定位，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与证据可信度评估存在概念联系，可供核查；但该工作是图像取证与水印，不涉及 VLM 推理状态。
